summary: Iteration 15 (Kairo rebrand + Platform Keys + Approved-Answer Analytics + RAG chunks + SSE inbox). Backend pytest 11/11 PASSED (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration15.py): auth regressions (master admin, demo client, old admin@rozio.ai=401, whitespace/case email), Platform Keys GET/PUT (Fernet-encrypted, masked readback ending in last-4, raw key never leaks, non-admin=403), Approved-Answer Analytics used_count increments after real /api/chat/stream call with matching correction, RAG PDF upload returns file record and stores chunks (chat query with PDF keyword returns 200 with no injection error), SSE /api/messages/stream returns text/event-stream + initial ping frame with valid JWT and 401 with invalid token. Frontend (Playwright) 100% PASS: Landing renders hero/demo-badge/kairo-logo/use-cases/features-grid/waitlist-reservation/footer; no 'Rozio' text anywhere in body; Client Login nav to /login OK. Admin System tab Platform Keys card shows resend-key-input/resend-sender-input/platform-keys-save; saving a key immediately shows green resend-connected-badge. Audit tab lists 14 rows. View-As demo@client.com lands on /dashboard with orange impersonation-banner + exit-view-as-btn. Client Settings→Training shows training-analytics + training-total-uses. Messages inbox shows pulsing inbox-live-indicator with zero SSE console errors (EventSource opens cleanly). Exit View As returns to /admin. Zero JS console errors during full flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2345 lines — long-overdue for splitting into routers (auth, admin, platform_keys, training, chat_stream, sse). Same feedback carried from iteration_14.
Dashboard.jsx is 1136 lines with MessagesInbox, TrainingCenter, SettingsPanel, KnowledgeBase all inline — should be extracted for readability and code-splitting.

SSE endpoint /api/messages/stream authenticates via ?token= in the URL. Full JWTs will end up in web server access logs / browser history — consider a short-lived one-shot stream-ticket exchanged for the SSE connection instead of shipping the primary JWT in the query string.

chat_stream corrections analytics increments used_count for EVERY chat that has any correction defined for the tenant — regardless of whether the visitor's question is actually related. Metric is closer to 'exposure to LLM' than 'actual use'. Might want to gate the $inc on keyword overlap between the visitor message and the correction question.
GET /api/admin/platform-keys performs Fernet decrypt on every call just to compute the mask — same hot-path critique as iteration_14; store a masked_hint at write time.

SSE gen() runs 300 iterations of asyncio.sleep(2) inside a request handler — if the client disconnects mid-stream, there's no cancellation check (the loop keeps running until 10 min elapses). Wrap in try/except CancelledError or check disconnect via request.is_disconnected().
